Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_169795.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_169795.v · Open raw
module origen_169795(
    input PCLK,
    input RESET,
    input PushButton,
    input DMA0_Ready,
    input DMA0_Watermark,
    input DMA1_Ready,
    input DMA1_Watermark,
    input Select,
    output reg WR,
    output reg RD,
    output reg LastWRData,
    output [7:0] LED,
    output User,
    inout [31:0] DQ
);

reg RUN_Sync0, RUN_Sync;
reg [31:0] Counter;
reg [2:0] state;

localparam IDLE = 3'b000,
          WAIT4DMA = 3'b001,
          DRIVE = 3'b010,
          WRITE = 3'b011,
          PAUSE_W = 3'b100,
          READ = 3'b101,
          PAUSE_R = 3'b110,
          STOP = 3'b111;

always @(posedge PCLK or negedge RESET) begin
    if (~RESET) begin
        RUN_Sync0 <= 0;
        RUN_Sync <= 0;
        state <= IDLE;
        Counter <= 0;
        WR <= 0;
        RD <= 0;
        LastWRData <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        RUN_Sync0 <= PushButton;
        RUN_Sync <= RUN_Sync0;

        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (RUN_Sync) state <= WAIT4DMA;
            end
            WAIT4DMA: begin
                if (Select ? DMA1_Ready : DMA0_Ready) begin
                    if (Select) state <= READ;
                    else state <= DRIVE;
                end
            end
            DRIVE: begin
                WR <= 1;
                if (DMA0_Watermark) state <= PAUSE_W;
                else if (Counter == 32'hFFFFFFFF) state <= STOP;
                else Counter <= Counter + 1;
            end
            WRITE: begin
                WR <= 0;
                LastWRData <= 1;
                state <= IDLE;
            end
            PAUSE_W: begin
                WR <= 0;
                if (!DMA0_Watermark) state <= DRIVE;
            end
            READ: begin
                RD <= 1;
                if (DMA1_Watermark) state <= PAUSE_R;
                else if (RUN_Sync == 0) state <= STOP;
            end
            PAUSE_R: begin
                RD <= 0;
                if (!DMA1_Watermark) state <= READ;
            end
            STOP: begin
                WR <= 0;
                RD <= 0;
                LastWRData <= 0;
                state <= IDLE;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

assign DQ = (state == DRIVE) ? Counter : 32'bz;
assign LED = Counter[31:24];
assign User = {state, RUN_Sync};

endmodule
